[Certified on 11th November, 2011]: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE EFFECTIVE MANAGEMENT, ADMINISTRATION
OR REVIVAL OF  IDENTIFIED UNDERPERFORMING ENTERPRISES OR
UNDERUTILIZED ASSETS VESTED IN THE STATE THROUGH ALTERNATE
UTILIZATION AND THE PAYMENT OF COMPENSATION IN RESPECT
THEREOF; AND TO PROVIDE  FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH
AND INCIDENTAL THERETO.
WHEREAS in furtherance of the expeditious development
policies  being  expeditiously  implemented  within  the
country  in  the  backdrop  of  the  favourable    economic
environment,  the  Government,    having    regard    to    the
Directive  Principles  of  State  Policy  enshrined  in  the
Constitution, considers it necessary  and  expedient to ensure
to its people the maximum benefit from the limited resources
available,  by  securing  and  protecting  as  effectively  as  the
Government could, a social order in which social, economic
and political justice would prevail:
